svg.title: Bashair AI · WhatsApp
svg.desc: Bashair AI · WhatsApp — RAG assistant. A WhatsApp assistant that answers from a RAG knowledge base and remembers personal facts about each person it talks to. Pipeline: WhatsApp → Baileys → Chroma retrieval → Groq LLM → per-user memory. Built with Node.js, LangChain, Chroma, Groq, Baileys.
svg.text: A WhatsApp assistant that answers from a RAG
knowledge base and remembers personal facts
about each person it talks to.
